switchSteps.title: 1. Map one client first
switchSteps.body: List the client’s profiles, formats, scheduled posts and reviewers. Check which integrations and early-access features are live in your Postial workspace.

switchSteps.title: 2. Pilot the approval flow
switchSteps.body: Start the 14-day trial without a card. Recreate a small set of drafts and, when enabled, test an Agency approval link with a reviewer. Check publishing status and recovery before expanding.

switchSteps.title: 3. Move only verified workflows
switchSteps.body: Reconnect supported profiles and rebuild schedules in small batches. Remove duplicate scheduled posts in the old tool. Keep unsupported networks there until Postial support is available; no automatic history import is promised.

pages.vendorFits: Hootsuite is the stronger fit when you need its already listed Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn integrations. Professional includes custom reporting; Advanced adds team approvals. Agencies dependent on these capabilities should validate Postial’s narrower rollout before moving.

faq.question: Is Postial cheaper for a five-person agency?
faq.answer: Postial Agency lists €49/month including VAT for 5 users and 15 brands. Hootsuite Professional’s five-seat arithmetic is $995/month on annual billing before taxes. Currencies, billing periods and capabilities differ; these are not equivalent bundles.

faq.question: Can Hootsuite clients approve without a login?
faq.answer: The checked pricing page lists team approvals on Advanced, but does not establish login-free external approval links. Confirm that workflow with Hootsuite. Postial provides login-free Agency client links today.

faq.question: Should an Instagram-focused agency switch now?
faq.answer: Postial’s Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn support depends on platform approval. Keep workflows that require those networks in a supported tool until availability is confirmed.

faq.question: Do both trials require a credit card?
faq.answer: Neither Postial nor Hootsuite requires a card for its listed 14-day trial. Postial is early access, so use the trial to verify the features your clients need.

pages.fits: Postial fits teams that want a managed service hosted in Germany and a plan defined around brands and five teammates. Its Agency client approval links are designed for reviewers without accounts. Client approval links are available today on Agency.
pages.vendorFits: Postiz fits teams that want to self-host or need a broader network selection today. Its documented API and n8n node already support automation. Unlimited team members on eligible cloud plans can suit teams larger than Postial Agency’s five-user allowance.

faq.question: Is Postial an open-source or self-hosted Postiz replacement?
faq.answer: Postial is presented here as a managed service hosted in Germany. Postiz offers an open-source self-hosting option; operating its server and integrations remains your responsibility.

faq.question: Does Postiz Pro cover fifteen brands?
faq.answer: Pro lists 30 channels and unlimited team members for $49/month. Fifteen brands fit that account allowance only if they use at most 30 connected profiles combined; brands and channels are different units.

faq.question: Is API automation unique to Postial?
faq.answer: No. Postiz documents a public API and custom n8n node. Postial Agency includes REST API and webhooks today, and n8n-nodes-socialmint 0.1.0 is available on npm; the Postial-branded release is coming.

faq.question: Can clients review Postial posts without signing up?
faq.answer: Login-free client approval links are available on Agency today, including during the 14-day trial without a card. The checked Postiz sources do not establish an equivalent login-free review flow.
